faq.q: What is the origin of Aishah?
faq.a: Aishah is associated with Arabic. Variant romanization of عائشة.
Yes — the underlying form عائشة is Arabic.
Aishah can occur in Muslim naming contexts, but it is better described as a Arabic-origin name used within some Muslim naming traditions than as an exclusively Islamic religious term.
Aishah should not be classified as a Quranic personal name without a direct Quranic basis. عائشة is not a Qur'anic form; it is the name of ʿĀʾisha bint Abī Bakr in the hadith and sīra tradition

faq.a: Romanization variants include Aishah, aishah. Script forms are عائشة, عائشہ, عايشه, आइशा.

faq.a: Documented usage records this form as female. Gender is not inferred from the meaning of the word, and actual use may vary between communities.
